made_by: by hand (round 3): the scientist's round-2 card made with src.calibration_card v1 (imaging statistics), the round-1 example card (cells, S, counts) and the scientist's own 3x3 statements; the keys listed in 'assumed' are not measured with tool v2
source: 8 private optical micrographs of a coarse elongated cell structure with hand-corrected masks (only numbers shared)

assumed.contrast_local_p25: the round-1 example card's contrast, which the scientist measured with a 3x3 window and a local interior reference (their own code, not tool v2)
assumed.gap_run_p50_px: assumed: short gaps between beads; to be replaced by the scientist's tool-v2 card
assumed.gap_share_gt5: assumed, kept consistent with 1-3 % invisible under the 5x5 window (runs over 5 px with 3x3 are gaps of 8+ px, which a 5x5 window sees too); 0.2-0.4 would exceed the whole invisible share (0.13-0.21)
assumed.soft.contrast_local_median: the round-1 example card's soft contrast (the scientist's 3x3 measure)
assumed.soft.invisible_fraction_local: the round-1 example card's soft invisible share (the scientist's 3x3 measure)

notes.measures: contrast_* and invisible_fraction_* are tool v1 (5x5 window, global interior); *_local are the 3x3 window with a local interior level (tool v2)
notes.transverse_boundaries: the end-to-end boundaries are not fainter than those along the cells
notes.scratches: hairline scratches at ~45 deg to the cells; a thick dark scratch ~20 deg off the cell direction
notes.cell_width_variation: within an image cell widths vary by about 2x
